messages:
maria_cs: FYI we just got a support ticket from @SonicDrive — free trial credits (promo TRIAL2026) landed on their dev workspace instead of their main org after SSO provisioning. Customer is understandably upset, asking for credits on their production workspace. attaching account IDs and repro steps they sent.

aj_engineer: Can you paste the org_id and workspace_id? I can look up the allocation.

maria_cs: org_id: org_8nXY3, intended_workspace: ws_prod_201, credited_workspace: ws_201_dev. Customer says they followed the SSO invite link from their IdP and the first workspace that got created was the -dev one.

sam_billing: Logged a billing case. We need confirmation from eng before we move credits. Do we have logs showing promo assignment event?

priya_support: I pulled an event log for promo redeem: promo-bot recorded assignment at 2026-11-04T13:12:05Z -> {user: u_993, workspace: ws_201_dev, promo: TRIAL2026}. Asking @devon_eng if there are known race issues when SSO creates both an org and a workspace.

devon_eng: :eyes: Not a widely reported one but there was one fix last quarter around invite flows. Can you run a quick DB query to show workspace.created_at vs org.linked_at for that org? If linked_at is after the workspace create, promo-handler might have used the first workspace it saw.

priya_support: Running query now, snippet I used:
```sql
SELECT w.id, w.created_at, o.id AS org_id, o.linked_at
FROM workspaces w
LEFT JOIN orgs o ON w.org_id = o.id
WHERE o.id = 'org_8nXY3'
ORDER BY w.created_at ASC;
```
Result (sanitized):
- ws_201_dev, created_at: 2026-11-04T13:12:00Z
- ws_prod_201, created_at: 2026-11-04T13:12:02Z
org.linked_at: 2026-11-04T13:12:06Z

maria_cs: So the dev workspace was created first, then prod, then org linked. Customer said they clicked one invite link — likely IdP created both entries in quick succession.

aj_engineer: That ordering explains the assignment. Promo handler assigns to the earliest workspace under the org if org isn't linked yet. We should not surface the promo until org linkage completes.

sam_billing: Ok, we can manually reassign the credits but need an audit trail and customer approval. Maria, can you confirm customer wants credits moved from ws_201_dev -> ws_prod_201 and keep both workspaces?

maria_cs: Customer confirmed, wants credits on prod and keep dev separate. They asked for ETA and whether this will reoccur for other users.

devon_eng: I'll create a one-off job to move the promo allocation and write an audit row. Also opening internal bug: runtime#4521 — race condition in promo assignment during SSO provisioning. Proposed mitigation: block promo assignment until org.linked_at exists or delay 10s and re-check for newly created workspaces.

priya_support: For the manual move I need a support-approved ticket body to run the transfer. Sam, can you give final okay?

sam_billing: Approve. Please include: customer confirmation (screenshot), original promo code, original assignment event id, target workspace id. Chargebacks: none.

maria_cs: Uploaded confirmation from customer and screenshot of their console.

priya_support: Done — ran transfer job, allocation moved, invoice/billing metadata updated, audit entries created. Promo-bot posted event:
```json
{ "event": "promo_transfer", "from": "ws_201_dev", "to": "ws_prod_201", "promo": "TRIAL2026", "performed_by": "priya_support", "ts": "2026-11-04T14:05:10Z" }
```

promo-bot: Promo transfer completed and logged. :white_check_mark:

maria_cs: Customer confirmed receipt of credits and said they can proceed. They asked what caused it again — explained race window during SSO provisioning and that we're patching.

devon_eng: Filed patch PR and linked runtime#4521, will follow up with a hotfix to change assignment to wait for org.linked_at or use a temporary hold. Also adding a nightly reconciliation job to detect promo assignments to newly created workspaces where org.linked_at > workspace.created_at + 5s.

sam_billing: Marking billing case resolved after reconciliation confirmation.

maria_cs: Closing with customer; leaving follow-ups: 1) dev-oncall to review PR 2) CS to confirm similar customers affected in a bulk check 3) Product to consider UX change for promo redemption during SSO flows.

devon_eng: Thanks all. :tada:
